method: Native ordinary game loop, 120 wall seconds, no time acceleration or forced path. Natural snow begins at zero; AutoWalk is enabled at 30s and stopped at 110s using its ordinary button. Native VP9/Opus canvas8fps plus the actual post-limiter audio bus; indexed by packet-copy only. SwiftShader capture timings are not physical GPU performance.
